learning_extracted: SD-074 works as specified: warmup raises the readable-seed fraction from 0.357 (untrained) to 0.786 at 25 episodes, with a paired rescue of 6 seeds and zero losses.

The durable statistic is the paired rescue asymmetry, not the yield fraction. The yield criterion is threshold-sensitive (breaks at a 0.85/0.15 band); the rescued>0 / lost=0 asymmetry holds at every band from 0.80 to 0.99. Future SD-074 consumers and any re-validation should assert the paired asymmetry.

Checkpoint-within-seed designs should test PAIRED. The pairing was built into 784's design (one incrementally-trained agent per seed) but the criteria tested only marginal per-budget fractions, discarding statistical power the design had already paid for. Generalisable to future budget-sweep scripts.
Thresholded regime labels are a lossy DV when the underlying statistic clusters near the cut (3/14 seeds within 0.02 of the ceiling boundary at b25). Record and prefer the continuous quantity.

The instrument-anchor pattern is worth propagating: proving a control precondition reachable at setup by scoring the REFERENCE run's own recorded values through the SHIPPED predicate (assert_anchor_reachable) is what makes the control interpretable rather than assumed.

Declining a flattering comparator is itself a scope guard. baseline_comparator's explicit refusal of 777a's authority-gated 0.286 in favour of the like-for-like 0.357 is what keeps this run clear of MECH-063 -- the pattern to cite for future substrate-validation runs routed by a braked cluster.

process_observations.generalisable_lesson: A structural search over a shared JSON file that returns ZERO hits should be treated as suspect until the container key is confirmed, precisely because a wrong key path fails silently rather than raising. An empty result is evidence about the query at least as often as it is evidence about the data.

incidental_repair.why_guard_missed_it: CLAUDE.md's detector is `git status --porcelain | grep '^ D'` and its remedy is `git ls-files --deleted -- :/ | xargs -0 git checkout --`. Both read the INDEX. In this variant the paths were removed from the index as well, so the code is 'D ' (staged), not ' D' (unstaged). Both documented commands returned ZERO while 12 evidence files were missing -- a false all-clear. The `git checkout --` remedy would also have failed, since it restores from the index and these paths have no index entry.
incidental_repair.correct_remedy: git -C <repo> checkout HEAD -- <paths>   (restores index AND worktree from HEAD)
incidental_repair.consequence_if_unnoticed: The next plain `git commit` in REE_assembly would have landed all 12 deletions, and build_experiment_indexes.py would have rebuilt with three runs silently absent -- including this autopsy's own target. Silent evidence loss reached by a path CLAUDE.md's check does not cover.
incidental_repair.adjudication_independent_of_repair: The entire adjudication was performed read-only from HEAD blobs and does not depend on the repair.
